quirks.label: Zoomer
quirks.desc: Randomly rockets across the tank for no reason.

quirks.label: Glutton
quirks.desc: First to the food, last to leave it.

quirks.label: Picky eater
quirks.desc: Turns its nose up at pellets. Only veggies and wafers will do.

quirks.label: Climber
quirks.desc: Likes to sit on the very tip of the tallest plant.

quirks.label: Filter hugger
quirks.desc: Spends hours picking at the sponge filter.

quirks.label: Night owl
quirks.desc: Hides by day and comes alive when the lights go out.

quirks.label: Wallflower
quirks.desc: Parks itself against the front glass and stares at you.

quirks.label: Dancer
quirks.desc: Swims in wide showy loops whenever there's an audience.

quirks.label: Bully
quirks.desc: Shoves others away from the good food.

quirks.label: Grumpy
quirks.desc: Gets stressed when the crowd gets too close.

quirks.label: Snail rider
quirks.desc: Has been seen hitching rides on the snails.

quirks.label: Obsessed
quirks.desc: Has become obsessed with one particular object.

quirks.label: Creature of habit
quirks.desc: Always molts in the exact same spot.

quirks.label: Early bird
quirks.desc: Somehow always knows when food is coming.

quirks.label: Bubble chaser
quirks.desc: Keeps trying to catch bubbles from the filter.

quirks.label: Brave
quirks.desc: Grazes right out in the open, even under bright light.
